transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Texas is suing OpenAI and Sam Altman, reported by Digital Watch Observatory, seeking to block minors from ChatGPT and require safety reviews.
Moonshot AI and DeepSeek say they used OpenAI's Astra when developing their latest models released this month, still open per TradingView.
Anthropic backs legal action against unsafe artificial intelligence systems, confirmed by Analytics Insight, urging California to allow court orders blocking models with serious public risks.
SK Hynix's artificial intelligence-driven memory demand surges, confirmed by KuCoin, with sales and profits up 328 percent and 632 percent year-over-year.
Hochul signs sweeping artificial intelligence restrictions in New York, confirmed by New York Post, banning chatbots from feigning emotions for kids and mandating baby monitor security.
Free every hour.
